references: Earlier generated 2048 cabinet concept from the referenced UX chat
reference.prompt: Create a production reference for ONE floor-standing 2048 arcade cabinet for the browser game La Baraj. First image gives cabinet silhouette only. Second image is the AUTHORITATIVE surface/style anchor: hand-painted stylized low-poly warm timber with intentional wood grain, dark worked iron with lighter worn beveled edges, broad readable forms. Match that second image's game-asset finish and material scale; avoid photorealism and excessive tiny scratches. Cabinet 1.82m tall, .76m wide, .72m deep. Forest-green painted side panels with subtle worn edges, thick medium-brown timber perimeter rails, forged iron brackets, iron footrest. Small cream illuminated marquee reading 2048. Portrait real 4x4 game screen recessed above control deck, top header 2048, SCORE and BEST, two actions NEW GAME and SCORES. Absolutely NO UNDO anywhere. Joystick on left, cream and terracotta circular control buttons on right. Lower service door with key slot and four small iron fasteners; two side ventilation slots. Keep ornament restrained: one simple ochre pine branch motif on side, no logos, no photographic dirt. Three-quarter front view large left and exact orthographic side smaller right, both same construction. Grounded neutral grey studio background, soft shadow, strong enough directional light to clearly show small bright metal bevel reflections. Perspective must not distort cabinet screen. Not a sheet of unrelated variants. Aim coherent game model that can be rebuilt at under 10,000 triangles using one 512px PBR trim set plus small flat-color materials.
reference.note: Concept dimensions were a starting hypothesis. The measured authored export is 1.913m high after screen/control clearance corrections.

paint.prompt: Produce ONE game albedo texture, full bleed square image, flat evenly lit, no text, no objects, no perspective, no cast shadows. Reference shows our accepted hand-painted stylized timber and forged iron trim texture. We now need its matching FOREST-GREEN PAINTED TIMBER surface for a low-poly arcade cabinet, same artistic family and broad restrained surface detail. Entire image is a continuous dark forest green painted wood panel, base target #284738 with subtle lighter desaturated green vertical timber grain. Very restrained hand-painted variation, smooth opaque paint, no camouflage blotches. A few narrow ochre-brown exposed wood grain lines, sparse edge wear near left/right boundaries. Fine grain follows straight vertical direction from bottom to top, low contrast so green reads as one clean surface at game distance. Do not reproduce the reference's grey iron bands or brown wood bands. No divisions, no planks gaps, no frame, no metal, no cracks, no photoreal dirt. This is an original efficient painted surface map, not a model render.
